We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support the delivery of privacy and cybersecurity compliance projects.
This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. Success in this role depends on exceptional written communication, team coordination, disciplined task management and precise documentation, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams with accuracy and consistency. You will work closely with attorneys and IT security professionals to ensure projects run smoothly, efficiently, and in alignment with client expectations.
This role is well suited for individuals with project management experience. We are also open to individuals with experience in executive/administrative support who are looking to grow into a project management career within a legal consulting environment.
Note: We will ask you to participate in a short skills assessment as a first step in the selection/interview process.

Coordinate and execute project plans within defined scope, timelines, and budgets
Maintain accurate and up-to-date project records, tasks, and documentation
Schedule client and internal meetings, manage calendars carefully across time zones, and ensure key meetings and deadlines are set up accurately
Attend client and internal meetings; produce accurate, complete, and well-structured meeting minutes with clear action items, owners, and deadlines
Monitor project progress, prioritize gating tasks, proactively flag risks or blockers, and provide timely updates and recommended next steps
Communicate regularly with attorneys, team members, and clients regarding status and next steps
Ensure adherence to internal processes, standards, and best practices
Support workload coordination across team members
Assist in documenting and improving business processes

Exceptional attention to detail and organizational ability
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset
Team player
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment
Proficiency with productivity and project management tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Asana, Jira, Teamwork)

4+ years of experience in project coordination or project management
Experience taking detailed meeting minutes and managing action items
Experience in professional services, consulting, legal, or technology environments preferred
Exposure to IT, cybersecurity, or compliance-related projects is a strong plus

Project management certifications (e.g., CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation)
Exposure to Agile methodologies
Background in legal, IT audit, or cybersecurity disciplines is a plus

Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
Paid Time Off (PTO)
Paid holidays
Annual bonuses
Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
Flexible working schedule in some roles
Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
Company laptop provided

Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe

Der notwendige Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien führt zu Volatilitäten im Energiesystem und stellt v.a. unsere Stromnetze vor große Herausforderungen. Genau hier setzt Luxera Energy an: Als Plattform für stationäre Batteriespeichersysteme (BESS) schaffen wir die notwendige Flexibilität, um erneuerbare Energien effizienter ins Stromsystem zu integrieren und leisten damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Energiewende.
Unser dynamisches Team aus derzeit 17 Mitarbeitenden vereint umfassende Erfahrung aus der Strategieberatung (MBB) sowie der Entwicklung, dem Bau und dem Betrieb von Batteriespeicher- und Erneuerbare-Energien-Projekten. Unsere Projektpipeline umfasst derzeit rund 1 GW an fortgeschrittenen Batteriespeicherprojekten. In den kommenden Jahren werden wir einen Teil davon selbst bauen und betreiben.
Hast du Lust, diesen Markt mit uns zu gestalten und in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Verantwortung für die ganzheitliche Projektierung von stationären Batteriespeichersystemen – von der Planung über den Bau bis zur Inbetriebnahme

Einholung der für den Bau erforderlichen Genehmigungen und enge Abstimmung mit unserem Technik- und Engineering-Team für die Planung der Anlagen
Mitwirkung am weiteren Firmenaufbau, beispielsweise durch die Erstellung von Analysen zu neuen Themen und die Verbesserung bestehender Prozesse und Tools
Qualifikation
Großes Interesse an erneuerbaren Energien, Speichern und der Energiewende

Unternehmerische Persönlichkeit mit einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative und Ergebnisorientierung
Analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Werde ein integraler Bestandteil unseres Teams, spiele vom ersten Tag an eine aktive Rolle in unserem Unternehmen
Einblicke und Auswirkungen: Du hast die Möglichkeit, in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen an der Spitze der Energiewende mitzuwirken und mit den spannendsten Themen und Technologien im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien zu arbeiten

Du bist bereit, die Zukunft der Energie mit uns zu gestalten?

Studien haben gezeigt, dass sich Frauen nur dann auf Stellen bewerben, wenn sie glauben, dass sie alle Anforderungen der Stellenbeschreibung erfüllen. Wir möchten dich dennoch ermutigen, dich zu bewerben, auch wenn du nicht alle von uns gewünschten Qualifikationen erfüllst.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and that can carry cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.
Storm is TEC’s high-performance liquid rocket engine program, developed to support next-generation launch and space transportation applications. The Storm development strategy relies heavily on ground testing, from early development models to qualification and acceptance campaigns. The engine test bench is a critical enabler of the program, and its on-time delivery is essential to maintain the Storm development schedule.
As Storm Engine Test Bench Program Manager, you are responsible for driving the on-time delivery of the Storm engine test bench development program.

You will ensure execution discipline across the bench development workstream: integrating schedules, tracking deliverables, coordinating stakeholders and suppliers, anticipating blockers, and escalating decisions to keep the program on track.

In addition, you will act as the primary point of contact for identifying and securing a suitable test bench location, coordinating the site selection process with internal stakeholders and external parties.

Program planning and delivery (schedule, scope, cost tracking)
Build, maintain, and continuously improve the integrated test bench delivery plan (design maturity gates, procurement lead times, manufacturing, installation, integration, and commissioning support activities).
Own the critical path , dependencies, and milestone readiness criteria (from a delivery perspective).
Track progress, identify schedule threats early, and drive recovery plans (re-sequencing, parallelization, expediting, resourcing proposals).
Maintain program routines (weekly reviews, action tracking, decision logs) to ensure execution discipline.
Cross-functional coordination and communication
Animate weekly/monthly routines: bench program reviews, schedule reviews, and interface meetings
Ensure alignment between propulsion engineering, test engineering, facilities/infrastructure, procurement, quality, and site teams
Prepare concise reporting for program leadership: status, risks, mitigation, upcoming decisions, and milestone readiness
Coordinate preparation of key internal reviews (bench concept reviews, design/package readiness, delivery readiness checkpoints)
Test bench location identification and site selection (point of contact)
Act as the single point of contact to identify, assess, and secure a test bench location aligned with the Storm schedule and development needs.
Coordinate the site selection process (timeline, stakeholder alignment, decision gates, and documentation) and ensure decisions are taken in time to protect the critical path.
With support from the engineering team (who define requirements and technical needs), consolidate the test site needs impacting the choice of location and translate them into:
A practical location assessment checklist (capabilities, utilities, access, constraints)
A comparison of candidate sites (schedule, cost, readiness, risks)
Clear decision packages for leadership (trade-offs, recommended option, fallback plans)
Coordinate interfaces with external stakeholders as needed (site operators, landlords/partners, utilities, local service providers), in alignment with internal owners.
Procurement and supplier coordination
Coordinate long-lead procurement tracking
Support supplier selection and onboarding (RFI/RFQ process coordination, delivery tracking, expediting)
Monitor supplier performance and ensure timely resolution of delivery issues, NCR handling coordination, and logistics readiness
Ensure documentation deliverables from suppliers are collected and integrated
Integration and commissioning readiness support
Ensure prerequisites for integration/commissioning are planned and tracked: procedures availability, resources, tooling, spares, training needs and documentation readiness (owned by responsible teams)
Track open points, coordinate closure plans, and ensure readiness evidence is available for management decisions.
Support lessons-learned capture and incorporation into the next iterations of bench capability
What we would like to see from you
Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or similar
Significant experience delivering complex test infrastructure or propulsion tests programs
Proven program management experience (planning, budgeting, risk, suppliers)
Strong understanding of propulsion testing, cryogenic systems, and hazardous operations
Experience with LOX/methane engine testing or cryogenic facilities
Familiarity with European space programs and standards (e.g. ECSS, ESA‑style reviews)
Experience with regulated industrial sites, permitting, or environmental compliance
Background in high‑cadence test operations
Ability to lead cross‑functional teams and make sound technical and operational decisions
Strong ownership and delivery mindset
Systems‑level thinking and interface management
Calm decision‑making during high‑pressure test activities
Strong documentation and reporting discipline
Fluent in English; French or German is a plus.

Vos tâches

s.h: Vos tâches se concentrent principalement sur deux domaines
s.t:
Développement de l’Ouvrage de référence en matière de technique ferroviaire
Vous êtes coresponsable du développement de l’Ouvrage de référence en matière de technique ferroviaire (RTE).
Vous soutenez méthodologiquement et techniquement les groupes de projet dans l’élaboration de nouvelles réglementations ou l’actualisation de réglementations existantes dans le domaine de l’infrastructure.
Vous observez les évolutions techniques et régulatoires dans le domaine du système ferroviaire et en assurez l’intégration dans le RTE.
Vous représentez les intérêts des entreprises de chemin de fer vis\-à\-vis des autorités et des partenaires, ainsi que lors de consultations.
Direction du portefeuille «Formation en technique ferroviaire»
Vous assumez la responsabilité de l’ensemble du portefeuille «Formation en technique ferroviaire».
Vous observez les évolutions de la formation en technique ferroviaire, en déduisez des mesures en concertation avec différents organes de l’UTP et les mettez en œuvre. L’accent est notamment mis sur les formations destinées aux personnes qui appliquent les réglementations RTE.
Vous dirigez le «Forum des enseignants ferroviaires» et le «réseau Hautes écoles», et soutenez les institutions de formation (p. ex. les hautes écoles) dans la mise en réseau et la visibilité de leurs offres.
Vous promouvez la mise en réseau et l’échange au sein de la branche et avec des organisations partenaires (notamment Swissrail, Railplus, SSE, OFT) et représentez les intérêts de l’UTP dans les offres de promotion de la relève (p. ex. Railway Summer Camp ou Railway Talent Hub).
Votre profil
Vous détenez un diplôme universitaire ou d’une haute école spécialisée dans un domaine technique et des connaissances spécialisées en système ferroviaire.
Vous disposez de plusieurs années d’expérience professionnelle dans la branche des transports publics ou dans des domaines apparentés présentant un lien étroit avec les transports publics suisses.
Vous possédez des capacités analytiques et conceptuelles et pouvez exprimer des idées techniques complexes dans un langage compréhensible.
Vous travaillez de ère autonome et appréciez l’élaboration commune de solutions de branche.
Vous êtes de langue maternelle française ou allemande avec de bonnes connaissances de l’autre langue.
Notre offre
Nous cultivons un style de direction simple, dans lequel les hiérarchies horizontales encouragent des processus décisionnels rapides. Nous accordons beaucoup d’importance au dialogue. Nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs bénéficient d’une grande liberté: ils travaillent de ère indépendante et ont leur mot à dire.

De plus, nous prati quons des modèles de temps de travail adaptés aux familles et offrons des conditions attrayantes. Nos bureaux sont situés à dix minutes en tram de la gare de Berne. Strong organisational, planning and prioritisation skills.

A genuine interest in technology and delivering high-quality products.

At Zurich, our ambition is to put customers at the heart of everything we do and become the insurer of choice by building meaningful relationships that earn customer loyalty over time.
Over the past several years, we have made significant progress in building customer thinking into our strategy, products, services and ways of working. However, there is still more to do to ensure customer perspectives consistently shape decisions across the organisation and become embedded in our everyday mindset and culture. We believe better customer understanding leads to better business decisions.
The Group Customer Office plays a central role in this transformation, partnering with markets and functions around the world to ensure the voice of the customer is heard, understood and acted upon. Through customer, market and brand insights, we help the business better understand changing customer needs, identify opportunities for improvement and make decisions that strengthen customer loyalty, drive growth and create long-term value.
To support this effort, we are looking for a passionate, curious and commercially minded insights professional to join our Customer, Market & Brand Insights team. This role is paramount in translating our data and research into actionable insights that influence business decisions and drive meaningful change.
Working closely with markets, regional stakeholders and senior leaders, you will help evolve and deliver our global brand and experience insights tracking tools to deliver value to the business, ensuring customer understanding influences business decisions and actions.
As we continue to embrace AI and new analytical capabilities, we are also transforming how insight is generated and activated, allowing us to spend less time producing reports and more time influencing decisions and delivering impact.
Reporting to the Head of Global Brand Tracking & NPS, this role will focus on understanding how our brand health created through our products, services and experiences shapes customer perceptions and behaviours, and ensuring those insights are translated into actions that improve customer outcomes and business performance.

As a Supervisory Program Manager, GS-0340-15, your typical work assignments may include the following: Directs and oversees a major programmatic area involving planning, and program management activities related to UAS and C-UAS programs, policies, plans, strategies, frameworks, and initiatives.

Plans, organizes, directs, coordinates, controls, and evaluates the activities of subordinate organizations, teams, employees, and contractors supporting Department-wide and interagency UAS/C-UAS mission requirements.

Provides substantive operational support, strategic planning, executive-level advice, and program direction to address emerging UAS-related homeland security threats.

Ensures program activities are aligned with Departmental guidance, statutory authorities, operational requirements, Program Executive Office priorities, and senior DHS leadership direction.

Oversees the development, coordination, and implementation of UAS and C-UAS policies, plans, strategies, and frameworks, involving complex, sensitive, or unprecedented issues.

Advises the Executive Director of the Program Executive Office and other senior officials on UAS/C-UAS program issues, including statutory and policy authorities, limitations, stakeholder equities, resource needs, enforcement considerations, operational risks, technology capabilities, and privacy, civil rights, and civil liberties implications.

Leads activities to identify shared requirements, reconcile stakeholder equities, resolve policy or operational issues, advance program objectives, and support integrated approaches to UAS detection, mitigation, and homeland security protection.

Represents UAS/C-UAS program segments and organizational interests in meetings, briefings, conferences, working groups, executive-level engagements, and other coordination forums.

The Sales Enablement & Operations (SE&O) team plays an essential role in translating Microsoft-s commercial strategy into local execution and driving operational excellence to achieve strong business outcomes. The team brings together cross-Area insights, strategy and execution to accelerate transformation and enable Microsoft to deliver impact at scale.
As the Activation Go-to-Market (GTM) Manager for AI Business Solutions in Switzerland, you will help accelerate growth across Microsoft 365 and Cloud Endpoint solutions, including Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop. You will partner closely with Sales Excellence, Sales, Marketing, Consulting, Customer Success and Partner teams to translate strategy into effective local execution.
You will bring deep understanding of the solution area and market, use data and insights to identify opportunities, and help field teams turn strategic priorities into customer impact. You will drive alignment across teams, simplify execution, optimise pipeline opportunities and help ensure sellers and partners are equipped to deliver against business priorities.
We are looking for a highly motivated sales, marketing or go-to-market professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, influencing across a matrixed organisation and turning insights into action. You will act as a thought leader for the solution area, track business performance, identify opportunities and blockers, and create clarity across multiple stakeholders.
This role offers the opportunity to deepen your business acumen, build expertise across AI-powered productivity and cloud solutions, and influence how Microsoft brings its strategy to customers and partners in Switzerland.
Microsoft-s mission is to empower every person and every organisation on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realise our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Drive go-to-market execution for AI-ready productivity and security solutions, identifying growth opportunities across Microsoft 365, ME3 Suites and Cloud Endpoint solutions and translating strategic priorities into clear local execution plans.

* Build cross-functional alignment across Sales, Sales Excellence, Marketing, Consulting, Customer Success, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure priorities, processes, tools and business rhythms support effective execution.
* Partner with the Partner organisation to support local partner-led go-to-market activities, demand generation and market execution aligned with Microsoft strategy and solution-area priorities.
* Provide product and market leadership, bringing together customer, partner and field insights, competitive intelligence, sales trends and business performance to identify opportunities, gaps and blockers and inform go-to-market plans.
* Use data and insights to drive action, establishing effective business rhythms, monitoring performance and helping leaders and field teams prioritise investments, resources and opportunities that can accelerate growth.
* Create clarity and enable execution by simplifying complex concepts, communicating priorities effectively, removing roadblocks and influencing stakeholders across a matrixed organisation to deliver shared outcomes.

* Experience using business insights, market knowledge and performance data to identify opportunities and support commercial decision-making.

* Experience managing or supporting a product or solution portfolio, including demand generation, pipeline acceleration or sales activation.
